_readme: On-screen text of the two promo videos (index.html = landscape, tiktok/index.html = vertical). English is the source; the compositions carry it as their authored text. Other languages: l10n/<lang>.json with the same keys. 'subs' are the burned-in subtitles, one per cue in l10n/cues.json. An empty subtitle ("") merges that cue into the one before it (for word order). A \n in a subtitle is a preferred line break.
